notes: Source evidence, not real-device runtime certification. No migration or duplicate storage-key consolidation is performed.

Static default index/number and choices are exported without reading saved account data. Actions/readouts are not persistent scalar preferences. Backend dynamic menus/keys retain their existing callbacks.
An original counterpart or audit mapping does not imply identical defaults/choices or complete implementation. See classification and reason.

live-tv.reason: Native adds its own Xtream, Stalker, M3U/XMLTV accounts and EPG/player controls. The official discovery hub exposes addons, media servers and plugins, not this IPTV account/guide stack. Addon live streams are not equivalent IPTV configuration controls.

glass.reason: Native shader glass, blur/opacity/outline quality and accent-focus controls are additional to the official colour/theme and AMOLED controls; the shared colour-theme parent is not badged.

graphics-budget.reason: Native controls the SDL render canvas, effect ladder, SGSR/FSR/Lanczos upscaling and image texture memory budget. Official player video resolution matching, RGB565 decoding and player buffer budgets have different consumers and are not equivalents.

dual-subtitle-style.reason: Native has independent styling, placement, timing and reset for a simultaneously rendered second subtitle. Official secondaryPreferredLanguage feeds ordered track selection with one shared subtitle style, not a second independently styled overlay. Primary subtitle styling remains unbadged.

alldebrid.reason: Native adds AllDebrid credentials and explicit validation. Official connected-service credentials support Real-Debrid, TorBox and Premiumize; the shared providers are not badged.

provider-fallback.reason: Native adds ordered cross-provider/addon failure retries and per-provider attempt limits through fontefalha. Official preferred resolver/provider and stream preferences do not expose this independent retry policy. No resolver behaviour is changed here.

external-p2p.reason: Native supports an external LAN P2P server URL and connection test in addition to any embedded engine. Official P2P settings configure its embedded torrent engine; the shared enable and cache controls are unbadged.

seekr.reason: Native adds Seekr service enable/key/test, seek-thumbnail filmstrip and synchronisation offset controls. Official playback settings have no Seekr service or matching thumbnail-configuration controls. This does not badge a generic shared seeking feature.

retained-player.reason: Native retains a player pipeline/frame after exit and controls its retention lifetime. Official stream-link reuse caches a link; it does not retain the Native player pipeline. Keep both behaviours and keys distinct.

stats-layout.reason: Native adds size and placement options to its live statistics panel. Official advanced playback statistics provides the main overlay control; that shared parent remains unbadged.

native-layout.reason: Native adds profile-picker backgrounds/resume cards, friends/Mural/collection/tab styles, row-title styles, top menu placement and specific guide/agenda/profile menu visibility, or Dynamic/Stage layout backgrounds. Official home layout, Discover/sidebar controls, profiles and colour-theme controls remain unbadged; these are distinct extra sub-controls.

feedback-polls.reason: Native adds its credits-review prompt and in-app opinion polls. Official skip-credits, post-play recommendations, tracking comments and episode notifications serve different purposes and remain unbadged.

layout-detail-tuning.reason: Native adds independent hero metadata visibility/size and row/title spacing controls. Official hero/catalogue/rating/layout controls have no matching per-field visibility and spacing preferences. Shared hero enable, layout and rating controls remain unbadged.

ui-scale.reason: Native adds independent canvas/text/settings scaling, animation reduction, in-app logo colour and clock-format controls. These are separate from official font family, launcher icon, theme colour and OSD-clock enable controls, which remain unbadged.

extra-art-ratings.reason: Native adds a fanart.tv API credential and visibility for Metacritic user score, Roger Ebert and MDBList aggregate score. Official TMDB/artwork/Trakt fanart URLs are not a fanart.tv API credential; its MDBList visibility model has no controls for these three extra scores. Shared rating sources remain unbadged.

source-verification.reason: Native adds start-during-verification, connection warm-up and concurrent source verification. Official debrid link preparation and parallel HTTP playback connections use different pipelines and do not expose these controls. Preserve all policies; Stage B only classifies their UI.

extra-player.reason: Native adds a separate anime player override, duplication of a retained-player island item in Continue Watching, and an HTTP local-network diagnostic-log server. Official default player, Continue Watching and Sentry reporting controls are not equivalents to these additional controls.

discord-presence.reason: Native Discord Rich Presence uses its own account/device link and publishes playback presence. Official tracking controls are Trakt/Simkl/library/progress, not a Discord presence control; community/support links do not implement it.
